NETWORK.NAME: NoImprovementClozapine_F5_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest

drafting_lead=BNs/BN-07.xml inference-disabled draft; follow-up ongoing-treatment subset retained verbatim for states and edges; registration-scope nodes deferred to R7; missing root priors added and deterministic 0-1 workflow tables replaced with soft synthetic placeholders preserving each deterministic argmax
scope=follow-up no-improvement only; distinct package identity from R7 established_case_clozapine even where BN-07 is a shared lead

gate=encounter.kind == followup AND ClozapineTreatmentStatus == CurrentTreatment AND BaselineCurrency == linked_current AND PANSSPairCompleteness == both_complete_assessed; non-current status yields not_applicable, outdated or incomplete baseline or measure yields needs_clarification
no_cutoff_rule=No percent-change cutoff is encoded; a missing follow-up PANSS total is never mapped to no improvement

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineTreatmentStatus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine treatment status (current)
definition=CurrentTreatment takes precedence if presently receiving clozapine; otherwise past exposure versus never treated. Status only; no dose, unit, route, frequency, duration, or level is stored
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineTrialAdequate
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine trial adequate (clinician category)

definition=Clinician confirms adequate tolerated exposure and duration before labeling nonresponse. Source discusses adequate exposure and at least 8 weeks; no universal efficacy cutoff, no dose escalation rule, and no dose, level, unit, route, or frequency is encoded
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ResidualSymptomsOnClozapine
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Residual symptoms on clozapine (current)

definition=Current clinically significant residual symptoms on clozapine using repeated validated assessments with recorded instrument name and version. Leave unobserved when not currently treated. A 20 percent change does not by itself determine Yes or No
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ExposureInterpretationConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Exposure interpretation concern

definition=Clinician identifies adherence uncertainty, changed smoking or caffeine use, interacting drugs, unexpected concentrations, or invalid blood-sampling timing; not a numerical toxicity diagnosis. Prior-treatment relevance is assessed for current treatment only
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent safety concern (current)

definition=Clinician identifies need for urgent assessment: suspected severe neutropenia, myocarditis or NMS, severe or unresolved constipation, or acute psychiatric danger. Nonexhaustive externally assessed input; Absent is not proof of safety
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineExposureReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine exposure review (parallel flag)
definition=Review drug exposure and concentration interpretation during current treatment. Triggered iff current treatment and exposure concern Yes. Numerical dosing and restart protocols excluded
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: PersistentSymptomsReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Persistent symptoms review (follow-up pathway output)

definition=Follow-up pathway: outside scope when not currently treated; otherwise no residual symptoms prompts periodic review; otherwise adequate trial prompts specialist review of psychosocial care and augmentation options with no automatic ECT or polypharmacy; otherwise adequacy review. Urgent pathway takes precedence via deterministic flag
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review
